items.item:
6. Archiving an archived project, anonymising an anonymised one, erasing an
   erased Customer, lifting an unrestricted Customer, resuming a relationship
   that is not ended, making the active project active again, clearing an
   active project already clear and registering a registered session each
   answer the record unchanged: its revision, last-changed instant and access
   version stay, no audit entry is written and no confirmation id minted.
   Shows A05-1. [witness: verification:registry_a05_every_repeated_transition_answers_unchanged]

verdicts.why: The selected test exercises every named repeated transition and requires an accepted answer with `changed: false`; per case it compares the returned or reread record/access with the pre-repeat value. The shared repeat helper also proves every persistence table and the audit entries remain unchanged, preserving revisions, timestamps, and access versions and leaving no new audit entry in which a confirmation id could be minted.
